definitions.explanation: Two things that form a matching set or are meant to go together.
Used to indicate opposition or comparison between two sides, as in sports scores or matchups.

notes:
{対|たい} has two main uses: "versus/against" and "pair/set." The reading changes depending on meaning.

PRONUNCIATION:
- たい: "versus" meaning, used in compounds (⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧, ⟦{対象|たいしょう}→対象：03393_taishou⟧)
- つい: "pair" meaning (⟦{一対|いっつい}→一対：08928_ittsui⟧の⟦{花瓶|かびん}→花瓶：02867_kabin⟧)

VERSUS USAGE:
- A{対|たい}B: A versus B (sports, debates, competitions)
- N{対|たい}N: score format (3{対|たい}2 = 3 to 2)
- Common in sports broadcasts and news

PAIR USAGE:
- ⟦{一対|いっつい}→一対：08928_ittsui⟧の〜: a pair of ~
- {対|つい}になっている: forming a pair

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧: countermeasure
- ⟦{対象|たいしょう}→対象：03393_taishou⟧: target, object
- ⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧: opposite, opposition
- ⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧: response, correspondence
- ⟦{対立|たいりつ}→対立：04500_tairitsu⟧: opposition, confrontation
